questions.q: Which component of a computer system directly interacts with the CPU to transfer data?
questions.e: RAM sits next to the CPU and exchanges data with it directly. The disk is much slower.

questions.q: What does the acronym URL stand for?
questions.e: URL stands for Uniform Resource Locator.

questions.q: What is the role of RAM (Random Access Memory) in a computer?
o: Temporary storage for running programs and data
questions.e: RAM temporarily stores programs and data that are running.

questions.q: You can organize files by storing them in__________?
questions.e: Files are organised in folders.

questions.q: What is a light pen?
questions.e: A light pen is an optical input device.

questions.q: UNIVAC is___________?
questions.e: UNIVAC stands for Universal Automatic Computer.

questions.q: The capacity of 3.5 inch floppy disk was__________?
questions.e: A 3.5 inch floppy disk held 1.44 MB.

questions.q: MICR stands for_________?
questions.e: MICR stands for Magnetic Ink Character Recognition, used on bank cheques.

questions.q: EBCDIC stands for__________?
o: Extended Bit Case Decimal Interchange Code
Extended Bit Code Decimal Interchange Code
Extended Binary Case Decimal Interchange Code
Extended Binary Coded Decimal Interchange Code
questions.e: EBCDIC stands for Extended Binary Coded Decimal Interchange Code.

questions.q: CAD stands for_________?
questions.e: CAD stands for Computer Aided Design.
1 byte is 8 bits.

questions.q: BIOS stands for__________?
questions.e: BIOS stands for Basic Input Output System.

questions.q: ___________ is the key to close a selected drop -down list; cancel a command and close a dialog box.
questions.e: Esc closes a drop-down list and cancels a command or dialog box.

questions.q: ____________Is the functional key to display save-as box?
questions.e: F12 opens the Save As box in Microsoft Office.

questions.q: Data becomes____________when it is presented in a format that people can understand and use.
questions.e: Data becomes information when it is organised so people can understand it.

questions.q: The term___________designates equipment that might be added to a computer system to enhance its functionality.
questions.e: A peripheral device is extra equipment added to a computer.

questions.q: In Microsoft Access the Rows are also known as?
questions.e: In a database table, a row is called a record.

questions.q: The arrangement of elements such as Title and Subtitle, Text, Pictures, Tables etc are called?
questions.e: Layouts arrange titles, text and pictures on a slide.

questions.q: Which of the following are types of Sound files?
questions.e: WAV is a sound file format.

questions.q: In computer, ALU has how many units?
questions.e: The ALU has two units: arithmetic and logic.

questions.q: The Word Computer used for the first time in?
questions.e: The word computer was first used in 1613.

questions.q: From the following who invented Slide Rules?
questions.e: William Oughtred invented the slide rule in the 1600s.
